promptRules.camera: eye-level portrait photography, clean studio background, no props, no religious clothing, uncovered hair, contemporary secular clothing
promptRules.art: photorealistic people as transparent cutout stickers, thin colorful outline, minimal motion accents, bold game-show title text integrated beside the cutout, no large graphic clutter
promptRules.casting: primarily East Asian and white people, varied hair and skin tones, Black representation about 10 percent across the complete pack

poses.name: Shoulder Switch
poses.description: Two partners stand back-to-back, switch shoulders toward camera, then finish with matching confident smiles.
poses.title: SWITCH IT UP

poses.name: Mirror Lean
poses.description: Partners face opposite directions, lean their heads together, and finish with synchronized playful smirks.
poses.title: MIRROR LEAN

poses.name: Crossed Paths
poses.description: Partners cross past each other, turn outward, and finish shoulder-to-shoulder with one hand raised.
poses.title: CROSSED PATHS

poses.name: Reverse Dip
poses.description: One partner leans backward into a safe supported dip while the other frames them; both look up and laugh.
poses.title: REVERSE DIP

poses.name: Human Arrow
poses.description: Three friends form an arrow composition, center person points forward while the side friends lean inward and grin.
poses.title: HUMAN ARROW

poses.name: Stacked Cool
poses.description: Three friends stack diagonally, shoulders touching, with alternating chin lifts and synchronized cool expressions.
poses.title: STACKED COOL

poses.name: Orbit
poses.description: Four friends create a loose circle, each turning the next person's direction, then freeze with arms reaching inward.
poses.title: ORBIT

poses.name: Human Tunnel
poses.description: Two friends make an arch with their arms while two others lean through the center and point toward camera.
poses.title: HUMAN TUNNEL

poses.name: Fashion Snap
poses.description: Two women pose at offset angles, one hand near the jaw and one hand at the waist, finishing with editorial eyes.
poses.title: FASHION SNAP

poses.name: Triangle Pose
poses.description: Three women make a balanced triangle, center woman steps forward while the others mirror her hand line and smile.
poses.title: TRIANGLE

poses.name: Synchronized Tilt
poses.description: Four women stand in a tight row, tilt together in alternating directions, and finish with different playful expressions.
poses.title: TILT TOGETHER

poses.name: Double Hero
poses.description: Two men step wide, turn opposite shoulders forward, and finish in a comic blockbuster hero stance.
poses.title: DOUBLE HERO

poses.name: Shoulder Check
poses.description: Friends stand shoulder-to-shoulder, glance at each other, then snap their gaze to camera with matching smirks.
poses.title: SHOULDER CHECK

poses.name: Corner Formation
poses.description: Three men form a corner shape, center person leans in while the outer two frame him with their forearms.
poses.title: CORNER FORMATION

poses.name: Parents Frame
poses.description: Two adults make a frame with their arms around a child, everyone looks through the frame with warm surprised faces.
poses.title: FAMILY FRAME

poses.name: Wave Chain
poses.description: Family members stand in staggered depth, each raises one hand in a wave that travels across the group.
poses.title: WAVE CHAIN

poses.name: Kid Director
poses.description: The child stands in front giving a dramatic direction while the adults behind copy the child's pose and laugh.
poses.title: KID DIRECTOR

poses.name: Human Sun
poses.description: Five family members radiate from a center child, hands angled outward like sun rays, ending in bright smiles.
poses.title: HUMAN SUN

poses.name: Stair-Step
poses.description: Four friends form a rising diagonal with alternating levels, each points in a different direction, then freeze.
poses.title: STAIR-STEP

poses.name: Front and Back
poses.description: Two people face camera in front while two peek from behind their shoulders, creating a layered reveal and shared grin.
poses.title: FRONT + BACK

poses.name: Five-Point Star
poses.description: Five friends arrange as a star, each body angled outward while hands point toward the center.
poses.title: FIVE-POINT STAR

poses.name: Reaction Wave
poses.description: Five friends show a left-to-right reaction wave: shock, confusion, delight, laughter, then a final shared grin.
poses.title: REACTION WAVE

poses.name: Super Squad
poses.description: Three children pose at different heights with fists forward, then lift their chins in a joyful team finish.
poses.title: SUPER SQUAD

poses.name: Freeze Frame
poses.description: Four guests dance in different directions, then freeze in a balanced composition with big expressive faces.
poses.title: FREEZE FRAME
